C0737.title: Security Guards Turned Insider Accomplices in 123 Heists at Hubei Company
C0737.summary: External individuals Wang, Zhang and others in Gong'an County, Hubei Province, bribed security team shift leaders Gao and Wang Yi at Company Jia with 500 to 2,000 yuan per theft to act as insiders, colluding to steal stainless steel materials and cables. From January to October 2020 they committed 123 thefts involving 10 people, fencing stolen goods for over 820,000 yuan. The Gong'an County Procuratorate prosecuted the case for theft and concealing or disguising criminal proceeds.
